facts.text: Audrey and her friends went on a hike and discovered a stunning lake in the mountains several years prior to the session date.

evidence.quote: So a few years back my friends and I went on a hike and stumbled across this stunning lake in the mountains.

facts.text: Audrey and her friends sat by the lake, chatted, and admired the peacefulness of nature during their hike.

evidence.quote: We sat by it, chat and admiring the peacefulness of nature.

facts.text: Audrey described the experience of sitting by the lake as calming and something she will never forget.

evidence.quote: It really was! Nature and the lake were so calming, exactly what I needed.
